newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Discount Auto EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Discount Auto EPS view up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it raised its FY97 earnings per share estimate on Discount Auto Parts Inc to $1.70 from $1.65.

-- "We are maintaining our rating of 2-2 (market performer) despite estimate changes to the upside in light of our belief that current conditions will be short-lived," said analyst Beth Richard in a report.
-- EVEREN said the FY97 increase is due almost entirely to volume sales of freon, which is no longer being manufactured but in great demand.
-- Discount Auto Parts was trading at 23-1/2, up 1/8.
